title: Tradesman
exclusionReason: Cannot run on electricity alone (HEV/MHEV — gas engine structural)
adasStandard: Forward collision warning, automatic emergency braking, lane departure warning, rear cross-traffic alert, blind-spot monitoring (depending on package). Source: https://www.ramtrucks.com/2025/ram-1500/specs.tradesman.html
adasOptional: Adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go, lane keep assist, surround-view camera with available trailer view (with packages). Source: https://www.ramtrucks.com/2025/ram-1500/specs.tradesman.html
rearViewCameraNotes: ParkView rear backup camera with dynamic gridlines is standard on all 2025 Ram 1500 trims including Tradesman. Source: https://www.ramtrucks.com/2025/ram-1500/specs.tradesman.html
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-view 360-degree camera with available trailer view is offered as part of optional packages on Tradesman but not standard. Source: https://www.ramtrucks.com/2025/ram-1500/specs.tradesman.html
subscriptionFeatures: Uconnect Services subscription (~$14.99/month) for app-based remote start/lock/unlock, real-time navigation traffic. Navigation Package subscription for OTA map updates and Dynamic Range Mapping. SiriusXM subscription for satellite radio. Connect Wi-Fi PLUS subscription for in-vehicle hotspot. 10-year Safety & Security Package (automatic SOS, theft alert, roadside) included free with vehicle purchase. Source: https://media.stellantisnorthamerica.com/newsrelease.do?id=25241&mid=
drmNotes: The truck's core mechanical functions operate fully without connectivity. Uconnect 5 infotainment requires connectivity for OTA map updates, real-time traffic, remote-start-via-app, and similar value-add services that are subscription-gated through Uconnect Services (~$14.99/month) and Connect Wi-Fi PLUS. Key-fob remote start works without subscription. Source: https://www.driveuconnect.com/faq.html
killSwitchNotes: No federally-mandated impaired-driving-detection kill switch is present on the 2025 Ram 1500. Standard driver-attention monitoring exists via the Uconnect/ADAS suite but does not disable the vehicle. The federal NHTSA FMVSS rule for impaired-driving-detection has not yet been finalized as of May 2026.
knownIssues: Ram 1500 historically rated below segment average on Consumer Reports for electrical/infotainment reliability. The 3.6L Pentastar V6 has been in production for many years with known concerns around oil cooler housing leaks. eTorque mild-hybrid system has had occasional 48V battery-pack-related codes. Source: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/ram/1500/
recalls: Data unavailable: aggregated NHTSA recall data for specifically the 2025 Tradesman trim was not searched in detail; NHTSA recalls.gov tracks recalls at the vehicle level. Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
